items.title: Dua-e-Ibrahim (AS)
items.shortDescription: Aulad aur nasl ke liye dua
items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.translation: Ae mere Rabb! Mujhe aur meri aulad ko namaz qaim rakhne wala bana, aur ae hamare Rabb! Meri dua qubool farma.

authentication.roman: Quran - Surah Ibrahim, Ayat 40 - Yeh dua Hazrat Ibrahim AS ne apni aulad ke liye maangi thi.

items.title: Dua-e-Yunus (AS)
items.shortDescription: Mushkilat aur andheron se nijaat ki dua
items.arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.translation: Tere siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahi, Tu pak hai, beshak main zalimon mein se tha.

authentication.roman: Quran - Surah Al-Anbiya, Ayat 87 - Yeh dua Hazrat Yunus AS ne machli ke pait mein ki thi.

items.title: Dua-e-Ayyub (AS)
items.shortDescription: Bimari aur takleef mein shifa ki dua
items.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.translation: Beshak mujhe takleef pahunchi hai aur Tu sab raham karne walon se bada raham karne wala hai.

authentication.roman: Quran - Surah Al-Anbiya, Ayat 83 - Yeh dua Hazrat Ayyub AS ne apni shideed bimari ke waqt ki thi.

items.title: Dua-e-Musa (AS)
items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
items.translation: Ae mere Rabb! Beshak main har us bhalaai ka mohtaj hoon jo Tu mere par nazil kare.

authentication.roman: Quran - Surah Al-Qasas, Ayat 24 - Yeh dua Hazrat Musa AS ne Madyan mein apni zaroorat ke waqt maangi thi.

items.title: Dua-e-Zakariya (AS)
items.shortDescription: Aulad aur waaris maangne ki dua
items.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
items.translation: Ae mere Rabb! Mujhe akela na chhod aur Tu sab warison se behtar waaris hai.

authentication.roman: Quran - Surah Al-Anbiya, Ayat 89 - Yeh dua Hazrat Zakariya AS ne aulad ke liye burhape mein maangi thi jis ke baad Allah ne unhe Yahya AS ata farmaye.
